newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila share index surges 6.65 pct after peso fall.
newsitem.headline: Manila share index surges 6.65 pct after peso fall.

text.p: The Philippine stock market's main index surged by 6.65 percent to 2,678.24 points in the first 15 minutes of trade after the Central Bank announced it was allowing the peso to move in a wider range.
The composite index had opened 51.62 points, or 2.06 percent, higher at 2,562.77.
All the sub-indices of the stock market also surged.
Following the Central Bank's announcement on Friday, the peso fell 5.5 percent to 27.84 pesos to the dollar.
